suite: Module 37 — Android app code (Flutter web preview, ORDER_MODE=api) on the real local backend: Help › support, a new case, the conversation, retry safety, confirm / reopen / withdraw, another customer's case
note: The same Dart code as the APK, run in a 412×915 browser preview — not a device. USER DEVICE VERIFICATION = PENDING. No order is created by this run and no money moves. Attachments are not offered (NOT IMPLEMENTED).

results.name: A1 ANDROID — HELP: the Help screen offers "contact support" and "my cases" to the signed-in customer and reads the customer's cases from the backend; the old note that requests are not sent anywhere is not shown

A2 ANDROID — A NEW CASE: the form (category from the link, subject, message) sends the category, the subject, the message and the source ANDROID with an Idempotency-Key — and no priority, status, owner or queue; the BACKEND creates the case (CUSTOMER_SUPPORT, NORMAL) and the app opens it by its case number, status Open

A3 ANDROID — SUPPORT REPLIED: "My cases" marks the case "New reply" and "Waiting for your reply"; the case shows the customer's message and Support's reply; the internal note written on the desk is on no screen and in NO answer the phone received — and no answer carries a priority, an assignee, a target or a classification
results.detail: failed: - My support cases | Refresh | Every request you sent to FoodOnTheGo support, and where it stands. | Open | Closed | Contact support | 1 with a new reply from sup

results.name: A4 ANDROID — RETRY SAFETY: with the connection gone the reply is shown as "Not sent" and nothing is stored on the backend; Retry sends it with its client_message_id and it joins the conversation only then; the same id sent again writes nothing twice (one message more than before, not two)

A5 ANDROID — CONFIRM, REOPEN, WITHDRAW: a resolved case offers no reply box; "confirm" says CONFIRM and the case is Closed; the customer reopens it with a message (REOPENED on the desk, Open on the phone); "withdraw" asks first, says WITHDRAW and the case is Cancelled (USER_WITHDREW)

A6 ANDROID — NOT THEIR CASE, AND THE NOTICES: the case number of ANOTHER customer's case opens "Case not found" (the backend answered 404, nothing of it is shown); for the customer's own case the backend wrote one notice each for "opened", "support replied" and "resolved" — the reply notice leads to the case by its number (the app's route for that target is covered by its unit tests)
A7 NO SCRIPT ERROR in the app during the run (the blocked request of A4 aside)
Z1 CLEAN-UP: every case, message, note and support notice of this run is removed from the local database
